lines.en: label makotospring4:
scene nightsky
It was a normal night at the Miyamura family porn shop.
lines.zh: Miyamura 家色情店的一个寻常夜晚。

lines.en: scene makotodildofight1
And, for some reason, this is what “normal” looked like.
lines.zh: 出于某种原因，「寻常」就是这个样子。

lines.en: : Makoto! You do not yet realize your importance! You have only begun to discover your power. Join me, and I will complete your training!
lines.zh: : Makoto！你还没有意识到自己的重要性！你的力量才刚刚开始觉醒。加入我，我会完成你的训练！

lines.en: : With our combined strength, we can end this destructive conflict and bring order to the galaxy!
lines.zh: : 合我们两人的力量，我们就能终结这场毁灭性的冲突，为银河系带来秩序！

lines.en: : I’ll never join you. Nor will I ever forgive you for butchering the script of Moby Dick but so accurately remembering fight scenes from Star Wars.
lines.zh: : 我绝不会加入你。我也永远不会原谅你——把《白鲸》的剧本糟蹋得一塌糊涂，却能把《星球大战》的打斗场面记得一字不差。

lines.en: : Star Wars is cool! Why should I care about some dude named Ahab when he wouldn’t stand a chance against me — Lord Vader!
lines.zh: : 《星球大战》超酷的！我干嘛要关心一个叫 Ahab 的家伙，他连跟我——Vader 大人——交手的资格都没有！

lines.en: : Can the two of you knock it off, please?
lines.zh: : 你们两个能不能别闹了？

lines.en: scene makotodildofight2
: Production on the Official Dildo Saber has stopped and I only have a few of them left. The last thing I need is either one of you breaking the merchandise.
lines.zh: : 官方光剑假阳具已经停产了，我只剩下几支。我最不需要的，就是你们俩把商品弄坏。

lines.en: : Then our sidearms it shall be! To heart, Skywalker! It is here we discover who will win in this fateful final battle of dark vs. light.
lines.zh: : 那就用我们的备用武器吧！刺向心脏，Skywalker！就在这里，我们将见证这场宿命的终局之战——黑暗对光明。

lines.en: : And don’t play with the {i}regular{/i} dildos either. I understand that they are toys, but this is not the way they are meant to be used.
lines.zh: : {i}普通的{/i}假阳具也别玩。我知道它们是玩具，但不是这么用的。

lines.en: scene makotodildofight3
: You’ve said on like a thousand different occasions that sex toys are super versatile and can be used for all sorts of things outside of sex.
lines.zh: : 你说过一千次了，说情趣玩具用途广泛，除了性之外还能用在各种各样的事情上。

lines.en: : Yes, but combat isn’t one of them.
lines.zh: : 是，但格斗不在其中。

lines.en: : I’ve literally been whacked in the face by dildos {i}you’ve{/i} thrown at me to get me to stop studying before.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}之前还真的拿假阳具砸过我的脸，就为了让我别再学习了。

lines.en: : That never happened.
lines.zh: : 从没这回事。

lines.en: : One of them almost left a mark. Do you have any idea how embarrassing it would have been to go to school with a penis-shaped bruise on my cheek?
lines.zh: : 有一支差点留下印子。你知道如果我顶着脸颊上那块阴茎形状的淤青去学校有多丢人吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. People’d start thinkin’ Makoto’s into all sortsa weird stuff with a bruise like that. Which she definitely ain’t because she’s a good girl and I’m the slut here.
lines.zh: : 是啊。带着那种淤青，别人会开始觉得 Makoto 喜欢各种奇怪的东西。她才不是呢，因为她是好女孩，这里的荡妇是我。

lines.en: : Give it a rest, Miku. She already knows.
lines.zh: : 别说了，Miku。她早就知道了。

lines.en: : No she don’t. She don’t know nothin’. Ain’t that right, Maki?
lines.zh: : 她才不知道。她什么都不知道。对吧，Maki？

lines.en: scene makotodildofight4
: You know what? Why don’t the two of you just take the night off?
lines.zh: : 这样吧，你们两个今晚干脆休息吧？

lines.en: : Establishments like this require a certain level of maturity in order to be effectively managed and it seems to me like the two of you have no desire to live up to that tonight! I’ll handle restocking alone.
lines.zh: : 像这样的店需要一定程度的成熟才能管理好，而我看你们俩今晚压根不想达标！补货我自己来。

lines.en: : {i}Maturity?{/i} Since when is that word even in your dictionary? You giggled like a schoolgirl just an hour ago when I was talking about the wind blowing.
lines.zh: : {i}成熟{/i}？这个词什么时候进你的词典了？一个小时前我聊到风吹的时候，你还像女学生一样咯咯笑。

lines.en: : Heh. You said “blow.”
lines.zh: : 嘿。你说「吹」。

lines.en: : See? You think Miku gets a sense of humor like that from me? Absolutely not.
lines.zh: : 看见没？你觉得 Miku 这种幽默感是跟我学的吗？绝对不是。

lines.en: : You’re right, Makoto. It’s all my fault. All of this is {i}all my{/i} fault. Your immaturity. Your depression. Your extracurricular activities. It’s all because of me! Because I make you work in a place like this!
lines.zh: : 你说得对，Makoto。都是我的错。这一切{i}全是我的{/i}错。你的幼稚。你的抑郁。你的课外活动。全都是因为我！因为我让你在这种地方工作！

lines.en: scene makotodildofight5

: So how about I just rip the bandage off once and for all and fire you {i}both?{/i} Right now! Effective immediately. Please get out of my store — where you never should have worked in the first place.
lines.zh: : 那我干脆一次性把创可贴撕掉，把你们{i}两个{/i}都炒了怎么样？就现在！立即生效。请离开我的店——你们从一开始就不该在这儿工作。

lines.en: scene makotodildofight6
: You can’t fire me. I live here.
lines.zh: : 你不能炒我。我住这儿。

lines.en: : Yeah, and you can’t fire me either. Makoto lives here.
lines.zh: : 对，你也不能炒我。Makoto 住这儿。

lines.en: : Makoto lives {i}upstairs.{/i} And also the dorms, where she’s free to express her unrivaled maturity in ways that she will inevitably keep secret from me!
lines.zh: : Makoto 住在{i}楼上{/i}。还有宿舍——在那儿她可以尽情施展她那份无人能及的成熟，而且方式肯定全都要瞒着我！

lines.en: : But {i}this{/i} part of the building belongs to me. And if I say the two of you are no longer allowed in it, I mean it. Use the back entrance from now on. I’m changing the locks.
lines.zh: : 但{i}这栋楼的这一层{/i}是我的。如果我说你们两个不能再进来，那就是认真的。从现在起走后门。我要换锁了。

lines.en: scene makotodildofight7
: Wait, you’re actually serious? I thought this was all part of some weird joke.
lines.zh: : 等等，你是认真的？我还以为这都是什么奇怪的玩笑。

lines.en: : Do I sound like I’m joking, Makoto?
lines.zh: : 我听起来像在开玩笑吗，Makoto？

lines.en: : I don’t know. I’ve never heard you sound like this before. This is all so new and scary to me.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我从没听过你这种语气。这一切对我来说又新鲜又可怕。

lines.en: : Put the merchandise on the counter and leave. I have work to do and I don’t have any time for your snark.
lines.zh: : 把商品放到柜台上，然后出去。我有活要干，没工夫听你阴阳怪气。

lines.en: : I’ll work for free if it’s a money thing! I don’t want the work history on my resume to just be “fired from a porn shop after a few months.”
lines.zh: : 如果是钱的问题我可以白干！我可不想简历上的工作经历就写着「在色情店干了几个月被开除」。

lines.en: scene makotodildofight8
: A money th- no! The two of you should have never worked here to begin with! Don’t you get it?!
lines.zh: : 钱的问题——不！你们两个从一开始就不该在这儿工作！你们还不明白吗？！

lines.en: : Surrounding you with all of this stuff has normalized sex to the point where you’re now putting yourselves and your {i}futures{/i} in danger and I can’t live with that anymore!
lines.zh: : 让你们整天被这些东西包围，已经把性变得太习以为常，以至于你们现在正在把自己和自己的{i}未来{/i}置于危险之中，我再也受不了了！

lines.en: : This seems like a bit of an overreaction to a dildo fight, but message received. We will put down our weapons and get back to work.
lines.zh: : 因为一场假阳具大战反应成这样似乎有点过度，但明白了。我们放下武器，回去干活。

lines.en: : No, there {i}is{/i} no work anymore! I don’t want you here! I can manage the shop myself.
lines.zh: : 不，{i}没有{/i}活了！我不想让你们在这儿！我自己能管好这家店。

lines.en: : If you really need a job, I can talk to Haruka about getting you one at the cafe. Now, leave.
lines.zh: : 如果你真需要工作，我可以跟 Haruka 说说，让你们去咖啡厅做事。现在，出去。

lines.en: scene makotodildofight9
: Fine by me. I never wanted to work here anyway. I was just doing it to help {i}you{/i} out because I know you {i}can’t{/i} do it alone.
lines.zh: : 我没意见。反正我从来就不想在这儿工作。我只是想帮{i}你{/i}，因为我知道你{i}一个人干不来{/i}。

lines.en: : Well, {i}I{/i} want to work here! And just because I met some guy online that I’ve been doin’ the frisky tango with don’t mean it’s {i}your{/i} fault, Maki!
lines.zh: : 可{i}我{/i}想在这儿工作！我在网上认识了个男的，还跟他跳了「热辣探戈」，那也不代表这是{i}你的{/i}错啊，Maki！

lines.en: : Some girls are just born to be tossed around like a throw pillow and I happen to be one of ‘em! Ya can’t fight fate! But ya {i}can{/i} fight loneliness and that’s what we do here!
lines.zh: : 有些女孩生来就是被当抱枕甩来甩去的，而我正好就是其中一个！命运你反抗不了！但孤独你{i}可以{/i}反抗，而我们这儿做的就是这件事！

lines.en: : Inspiring. Like, really. But I’m your guardian, Miku. And I haven’t really {i}guarded{/i} you from anything, have I?
lines.zh: : 真励志。真的。但我是你的监护人，Miku。而我其实什么都没{i}护住{/i}你，不是吗？

lines.en: : Ya guarded me from that weird lady who tried gettin’ my phone number last week. Can’t we just call it even there?
lines.zh: : 上周那个想问我电话号码的怪阿姨，你不是替我挡下来了吗？就当扯平行不行？

lines.en: scene makotodildofight10
: I don’t think you’re helping, Miku.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你没帮上忙，Miku。

lines.en: : Me neither, but I ain’t got any idea what {i}else{/i} I’m supposed to do! I like workin’ here and I ain’t ever been fired before!
lines.zh: : 我也觉得，但我不知道{i}还能{/i}怎么办！我喜欢在这儿工作，而且我还从来没被开除过！

lines.en: : It’s just an impulse. She’ll change her mind the second Valentine’s Day rolls around and she can’t keep up with demand.
lines.zh: : 她只是一时冲动。等情人节一到、她忙不过来的时候，她就会改主意的。

lines.en: : That’s in like half a year! How am I supposed to keep track of the MILF of the month until then?!
lines.zh: : 那可是半年后！在那之前我要怎么追踪「本月最佳 MILF」啊？！

lines.en: : Wow. You really {i}are{/i} into this stuff, huh?
lines.zh: : 哇。你{i}还真是{/i}好这口啊？

lines.en: scene makotodildofight11

: Yeah! Cause Maki taught me it’s a normal part of life and not somethin’ people should ever feel ashamed of! But now {i}she’s{/i} ashamed for teachin’ me that and I don’t know what to believe all of a sudden!
lines.zh: : 是啊！因为 Maki 教过我，这是生活里正常的一部分，不是什么该感到羞耻的事！可现在{i}她{/i}又为自己教了我这些而羞耻，我一下子不知道该信什么了！

lines.en: scene makotodildofight12

: I’m sorry, Miku. But all I’ve been doing this whole time is teaching you how to end up with a dead-end job, a husband that’s even {i}more{/i} dead, and a daughter who hates you. Just forget all of it, please.
lines.zh: : 对不起，Miku。但我从头到尾教你的，不过是怎么走到一份没前途的工作、一个死得{i}更彻底{/i}的丈夫，还有一个恨你的女儿。把这些全忘了吧，求你了。

lines.en: : {i}Hah.{/i} Okay. Miku, can you go wait for me outside so I can remind my mom for the millionth time this month that I don’t actually hate her?
lines.zh: : {i}哈。{/i}行吧。Miku，你能先去外面等我吗？我好再提醒我妈一次——这个月已经是第一百万次了——我其实并不恨她。

lines.en: : Fine...Can I get one more look at Big Black, though? I ain’t sure if I’ll ever see him again.
lines.zh: : 好吧……不过能让我再看一眼「大黑」吗？我不确定以后还能不能见到他。

lines.en: : Yes, Miku. You can go say goodbye to the dildo.
lines.zh: : 行，Miku。你可以去跟那根假阳具道别。

lines.en: : No she can’t. I sold him last night.
lines.zh: : 不行。我昨晚把他卖了。

lines.en: : This day just keeps getting worse!
lines.zh: : 今天真是越来越糟了！

lines.en: scene makotodildofight13
: So, should I just come out and say how dumb this is or should I let you figure it out all by yourself?
lines.zh: : 所以，我是该直接说这有多蠢，还是让你自己想明白？

lines.en: : Mom, you really intend to work like seventy hours a week? You {i}need{/i} us.
lines.zh: : 妈，你真打算一周干七十个小时？你{i}需要{/i}我们。

lines.en: : The store’s hours can change. And I can hire help of the appropriate age should I actually need it.
lines.zh: : 营业时间可以改。真需要人的话，我可以雇年龄合适的帮手。

lines.en: : Well, good luck finding anyone willing to accept what you pay the two of us. You’ll be lucky if you even get an application with that.
lines.zh: : 祝你好运，能找到愿意接受你付给我们俩那点工资的人。就那点钱，能收到一份申请就算走运了。

lines.en: : Frankly, Makoto, the business is the least of my priorities now when I have two teenage girls running around who see no issue at all spreading their legs for someone old enough to be their father.
lines.zh: : 说真的，Makoto，现在我有两个十几岁的女孩到处乱跑，还觉得为一个年纪够当她们爹的人张开腿完全没问题，生意已经是我最不关心的事了。

lines.en: : Okay. Well, first off, Sensei would have had to be like my age when he got someone pregnant in order for that to be true. And second, we’re {i}fine.{/i} We know how to be safe. {i}You{/i} taught us.
lines.zh: : 好。首先，要让那句话成立，Sensei 得在我这个年纪就让谁怀了孕才行。其次，我们{i}没事{/i}。我们知道怎么保护自己。{i}是你{/i}教我们的。

lines.en: : I’m no saint, but I taught you better than {i}this.{/i} What would your father think if he were alive right now?
lines.zh: : 我不是圣人，但我教过你不该{i}这样{/i}。如果你爸现在还活着，他会怎么想？

lines.en: : {i}Please, help. I’m stuck in a space coffin. My family needs me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}救命，我被困在太空棺材里了。我的家人需要我。{/i}

lines.en: scene makotodildofight14

: That’s hilarious, but it’s not the point! The point is you should know better! You know {i}everything!{/i} So why would you go out of your way to be with {i}him{/i} instead of someone your own age?!
lines.zh: : 真好笑，但这不是重点！重点是你该更懂事才对！你{i}什么都懂{/i}！那你为什么非要跟{i}他{/i}在一起，而不是找个跟你同岁的人？！

lines.en: : Oh, I don’t know. Maybe the fact that all of the boys my age are {i}gone?{/i} And the fact that I actually really admire Sensei?
lines.zh: : 哦，我不知道。也许是因为跟我同岁的男生全都{i}不见了{/i}？还有我真的非常崇拜 Sensei？

lines.en: : {i}Why?!{/i} You’re smarter than {i}him{/i} too! This has far surpassed just admiration for a teacher at this point!
lines.zh: : {i}为什么？！{/i}你还比{i}他{/i}聪明呢！到这一步早就不是对老师的崇拜了！

lines.en: : Hey, you admired him for a while too. So you clearly saw something as well.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你也崇拜过他一阵子呢。所以你显然也看出了点什么。

lines.en: scene makotodildofight15
: Everything I saw was a lie. Just one big, well-acted facade that deterred me from ever even {i}thinking{/i} you were in danger around him. And boy, do I look stupid now.
lines.zh: : 我看到的一切都是谎言。只是一层巨大而演得很好的伪装，让我从来没{i}想过{/i}你在他身边会有危险。而现在，我看起来可真蠢。

lines.en: : I mean, I won’t say you’re {i}not{/i} to blame for not picking up on his...{i}preferences{/i} sooner. But it’s not like he just wears them on his sleeve to people his age. He’s ashamed of it too.
lines.zh: : 我不是说你{i}没{/i}责任——你没能早点看穿他的……{i}癖好{/i}。但他也不会在同龄人面前把这写在脸上。他也为此感到羞耻。

lines.en: : Sure didn’t sound like it when I talked to him about it.
lines.zh: : 我跟他说这事的时候，他可不像觉得羞耻。

lines.en: : Because he knows that nothing he says will make a difference when you’ve already made up your mind. So why waste the effort?
lines.zh: : 因为他知道，一旦你打定主意，他说什么都没用。那又何必白费力气？

lines.en: : You’re not going to wear me down this time, Makoto. I’ve ruined your life enough as-is and I’m not about to turn a blind eye to something like {i}this{/i} just because it would make you “happy.”
lines.zh: : 这次你磨不动我了，Makoto。我已经把你的生活毁得够呛，我不会因为这样能让你「开心」就对{i}这种事{/i}睁一只眼闭一只眼。

lines.en: : {i}Someone{/i} needs to say no to you every once in a while or you’re going to turn into a spoiled brat.
lines.zh: : {i}总得有人{/i}时不时对你说不，不然你会被宠坏的。

lines.en: : You’re missing a ton of context, Mom. You don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 你缺了太多前因后果，妈。你不懂。

lines.en: scene makotodildofight16
: Context...
lines.zh: : 前因后果……

lines.en: : You think {i}context{/i} is what will make me okay with my little girl sleeping with someone twice her age before she even graduates high school.
lines.zh: : 你以为靠{i}前因后果{/i}，我就能接受我的小女儿在高中毕业前跟一个年纪是她两倍的人上床。

lines.en: : Better be some crazy context, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 那最好得是相当离谱的前因后果，Makoto。

lines.en: : You have no fucking idea.
lines.zh: : 你他妈根本一无所知。

lines.en: : Do not curse at me either. I’ll have you know I read half a book on motherhood this week and it directly told me to not let you do that and how I should be treated with respect.
lines.zh: : 也不许对我爆粗口。我告诉你，这周我读了半本讲为人母的书，书里明确说了不许你那样，还说了我应该被尊重。

lines.en: : See, the thing about respect at this point to {i}me{/i} is that it really just doesn’t matter in any capacity or even circumstance. You’re not on a higher level than me.
lines.zh: : 你看，对{i}我{/i}来说，到了这一步，尊重这东西在任何意义上、任何情况下都真的不重要了。你并不比我高一等。

lines.en: : If anything, I’m on a higher level than {i}you{/i} since {i}you{/i} don’t even know where we are right now.
lines.zh: : 要说的话，是我比{i}你{/i}高一等，因为{i}你{/i}根本不知道我们现在在哪儿。

lines.en: : Excuse me?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: scene makotodildofight17
: In fact, I don’t even know if you’ll {i}remember{/i} that I’m sleeping with Sensei a few months from now if I sandwich it in with a bunch of information that needs to be deleted!
lines.zh: : 事实上，如果我把这件事夹在一堆需要被删掉的信息里说出来，我都不确定几个月后你还{i}记不记得{/i}我在跟 Sensei 上床！

lines.en: : Like, maybe I’m only doing it because we’re caught in a timeloop and I’m bored!
lines.zh: : 比如，也许我只是因为困在时间循环里太无聊才这么干的！

lines.en: : Maybe I only suck his dick because of the impending apocalypse!
lines.zh: : 也许我只是因为末日将至才给他口交的！

lines.en: : Maybe I stopped using condoms because I know I can’t exist for long enough inside of one timeline to see a pregnancy through to its unfortunate end!
lines.zh: : 也许我不用避孕套，是因为我知道自己在同一条时间线上活不到看着一次怀孕走到那个不幸的结局！

lines.en: scene makotodildofight18

: Hell, all {i}three{/i} of us could probably have sex {i}together{/i} and you’d wake up the next morning not knowing what even happened so long as we’re talking about {i}time{/i} the whole way through.
lines.zh: : 妈的，我们{i}三个{/i}大概都能{i}一起{/i}上床，而你第二天早上醒来时什么都不知道——只要我们全程都在聊{i}时间{/i}。

lines.en: : There are just so many rules you don’t know. Things that wouldn’t make sense in any {i}other{/i} universe but are totally fine in {i}this{/i} one because {i}this{/i} one is broken.
lines.zh: : 有太多你不知道的规则。有些事在任何{i}别的{/i}宇宙里都说不通，但在{i}这个{/i}宇宙里完全没问题，因为{i}这个{/i}宇宙是坏的。

lines.en: scene makotodildofight19
: So, yes — I have tons of sex with my teacher because time is unlimited and I am immortal.
lines.zh: : 所以，没错——我和我的老师做了很多爱，因为时间无限，而我不朽。

lines.en: : And I apologize that this makes you sad, but I am going to continue to have tons of sex with him because time is unlimited and I am immortal.
lines.zh: : 让你难过我很抱歉，但我会继续和他做很多爱，因为时间无限，而我不朽。

lines.en: : Which you can {i}also{/i} do, if you want! Since time is unlimited and you are immortal.
lines.zh: : 你也{i}可以{/i}这么做，想的话！因为时间无限，而你也不朽。

lines.en: : That’s just the way things are here. And I’m not about to be abstinent for the rest of eternity since your feeble mind can not comprehend the nuance of sex in a world where age is {i}literally{/i} just a number.
lines.zh: : 这里就是这样的。我也不打算为了永恒的余生守身如玉，就因为你那虚弱的大脑理解不了在一个年龄{i}真的{/i}只是个数字的世界里性的微妙之处。

lines.en: : Now, if you’ll please excuse me, I’m going to go call my {i}boyfriend{/i} and see if he wants to put his eternal penis inside of my infinite vagina because, again, TIME IS UNLIMITED AND I AM IMMORTAL.
lines.zh: : 现在，恕我失陪，我要去给我{i}男朋友{/i}打电话，问问他要不要把他那根永恒的阴茎放进我那个无限的阴道里，因为，再说一遍，时间无限，而我不朽。

lines.en: scene makotodildofight20
: Have you gone fucking insane?
lines.zh: : 你是不是他妈疯了？

lines.en: : Why aren’t you repeating your last line of dialogue?
lines.zh: : 你为什么不重复你上句台词？

lines.en: scene makotodildofight21
: Time is unlimited and you are {i}immortal?!{/i} Am I a joke to you or do you need anti-psychotics now too?!
lines.zh: : 时间无限而你{i}不朽{/i}？！我是不是在你眼里就是个笑话，还是说你现在也得吃抗精神病药了？！

lines.en: : W-W-Why aren’t you repeating your last line of dialogue?! Repeat your last line of dialogue!
lines.zh: : 你——你——你为什么不重复你上句台词？！重复你上句台词！

lines.en: scene makotodildofight22
: I’m calling your psychiatrist in the morning. I think your father’s death had a much greater effect on you than we initially believed. Until then, you are not to leave your room.
lines.zh: : 我早上就给你的精神科医生打电话。我觉得你父亲的死对你的影响比我们原先以为的要大得多。在那之前，你不许离开房间。

lines.en: : Wha...no! Hold on! You weren’t supposed to actually {i}hear{/i} any of that! That’s not how this works!
lines.zh: : 什……不！等等！那些话你本来不该真的{i}听进去{/i}的！不该是这样的！

lines.en: : Makoto...room. {i}Now.{/i}
lines.zh: : Makoto……回房间。{i}现在{/i}。

lines.en: : I...that...
scene makotodildofight23
: I’m gonna go sleep at the dorm tonight!
lines.zh: : 我今晚要去宿舍睡！

lines.en: : Makoto! Don’t you dare defy me! I am your-
lines.zh: : Makoto！你敢违抗我！我是你——

lines.en: scene makotodildofight24
: {i}Hello? What’s-{/i}
: We have a code red. I repeat. {i}Code red!{/i}
lines.zh: : 红色警报。重复，{i}红色警报{/i}！

lines.en: : {i}Finally. Someone’s trapped in a wall and only I can get them out.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}终于来了。有人被卡在墙里，只有我能把他们弄出来。{/i}

lines.en: : {size=-6}No, you idiot! I just confessed everything about us to my mom because I thought it would feel good to get it off my chest and {i}assumed{/i} that including information about the nature of the universe within those statements would be enough to make her instantaneously forget them all, but I was wrong!{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-6}不是，你这白痴！我刚把我们的事全跟我妈坦白了，因为我以为一吐为快会让我舒服点，还{i}以为{/i}只要在这些话里掺上关于宇宙本质的信息，就足够让她瞬间忘光，但我错了！{/size}

lines.en: : {i}Why did we reserve code red for something that specific?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我们为什么把红色警报留给这么具体的一件事？{/i}

lines.en: scene makotodildofight25
: What am I supposed to do now?! How am I supposed to look her in the eye again after telling her I’m going to call you and ask you to put your eternal penis inside of my infinite vagina?!
lines.zh: : 我现在该怎么办？！我都跟我妈说了我打算打电话给你，问你要不要把你那根永恒的阴茎放进我那个无限的阴道里，我还怎么直视她的眼睛？！

lines.en: : {i}Sorry. My what?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}抱歉。我的什么？{/i}

lines.en: : I even mentioned a {i}threesome{/i} too! My life is fucking over! Immortality is a curse after all! Why must I shoulder this burden?!
lines.zh: : 我还提了{i}三人性交{/i}！我的人生彻底完了！原来不朽是诅咒！为什么这个重担要我来扛？！

lines.en: : {i}Makoto, I think the more important thing here is that your mom is an outlier now. This is...a big deal, I think.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Makoto，我觉得更重要的是，你妈现在成了个异类。这……我觉得是件大事。{/i}

lines.en: : Makoto...can we go to McDonald’s now?
lines.zh: : Makoto……我们现在能去麦当劳了吗？

lines.en: scene makotodildofight26
: Not right now! I’m in the middle of a crisis!
lines.zh: : 现在不行！我正在危机当中！

lines.en: scene makotodildofight27
: So, how are we going to kill her?
lines.zh: : 那么，我们要怎么杀了她？

lines.en: : {i}What? We’re not. That’s not why this is a big deal.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}什么？我们不杀。这不是它成为大事的原因。{/i}

lines.en: : If we kill her, she’ll forget. Right? I mentioned blowjobs too. I said pretty much everything. And now I have to explain all of this to my {i}psychiatrist{/i} next, so that’s just {i}great.{/i}
lines.zh: : 如果我们杀了她，她就会忘掉。对吧？我还提了口交。我基本什么都说了。现在我还得跟我的{i}精神科医生{/i}解释这一切，真是{i}太棒了{/i}。

lines.en: : {i}How did this even come up? Did she confront you again or-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这到底是怎么扯出来的？她又找你对质了还是——{/i}

lines.en: : It doesn’t matter {i}how{/i} it came up! Just that it {i}did{/i} and my plan immediately backfired and now I look {i}crazy{/i} because who in their right mind would fucking believe that?!
lines.zh: : {i}怎么{/i}扯出来的不重要！重要的是{i}扯出来了{/i}，而我的计划立刻翻车了，现在我看上去像个{i}疯子{/i}，因为脑子正常的人他妈谁会信那种话？！

lines.en: : {i}Miku’s there too, right? Have you tried doing the same with her?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Miku 也在那儿吧？你有没有对她试过同样的话？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}No, hold on.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}没有，等等。{/i}

lines.en: scene makotodildofight28
: Miku! We’re caught in a time paradox and I hate that shirt!
lines.zh: : Miku！我们被困在时间悖论里了，而且我讨厌那件衬衫！

lines.en: : Makoto...can we go to McDonald’s now?
lines.zh: : Makoto……我们现在能去麦当劳了吗？

lines.en: scene makotodildofight27
: Okay, Miku’s still broken. And by broken, I mean normal.
lines.zh: : 好吧，Miku 还是坏的。所谓坏的，意思是正常的。

lines.en: : {i}So it’s just...Maki who is apparently in on things now?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}所以现在就只有……Maki 显然知道了？{/i}

lines.en: : In addition to Nodoka and Uta, yes. But-
lines.zh: : 除了 Nodoka 和 Uta 之外，是的。不过——

lines.en: : {i}Listen...I can’t talk to her. And it’s not like any of the other girls can either, so this one’s going to be on you, Makoto.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}听着……我没法跟她谈。其他女孩也都不行，所以这件事只能靠你了，Makoto。{/i}

lines.en: scene makotodildofight24

: Were you not listening?! How the fuck am I supposed to face her after saying all of that stuff?! She thinks I’ve gone insane! I can’t have a serious talk with her about {i}anything{/i} right now, let alone chronometry!
lines.zh: : 你没在听吗？！说了那些话之后我要怎么面对她？！她觉得我疯了！我现在根本没法跟她认真谈{i}任何事{/i}，更别提时间学了！

lines.en: : {i}I’m sure you’ll figure it out. You know words like “chronometry.” And your mom loves you, believe it or not.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我相信你能搞定。你连「时间学」这种词都会。而且不管你信不信，你妈是爱你的。{/i}

lines.en: : Not for much longer since her perception of me is now tainted by sexual imagery! Can’t you just get over here and tell her I’m not crazy?
lines.zh: : 长不了了，因为她对我的印象现在已经被性画面污染了！你就不能过来一趟，告诉她我没疯吗？

lines.en: : {i}Yeah. That’d work flawlessly, I’m sure.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}对。那肯定万无一失。{/i}

lines.en: : I still think we should kill her and experiment with resets that way.
lines.zh: : 我还是觉得我们应该杀了她，用这种方式做重置实验。

lines.en: : {i}Goodnight, Makoto. And good luck.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}晚安，Makoto。祝你好运。{/i}
